verdict.rationale: Superset is an orchestration layer for third-party CLI agents rather than an agent itself. You can describe a bugfix task, pick an agent such as Claude Code or Codex, and it starts working immediately in an isolated worktree (docs-18, docs-26, docs-6). You then review what it did in the Changes tab and commit or open a PR from the diff viewer (docs-4, docs-5, docs-17). The diagnosis and fixing itself is delegated to whichever external agent you bring, and nothing shows a flow from a reported bug to a fix. Missing for 10: first-party diagnosis/debugging capability, documented ingestion of bug reports or issues into agent tasks, and hands-on corroboration of agents autonomously fixing reported bugs.
